# Pax Health

> Pax Health is a Miami-based telehealth clinic for longevity, hormone, recovery, and weight care. Independent U.S.-licensed clinicians review each member's intake and bloodwork. Pax is not a pharmacy; fulfillment occurs through licensed pharmacy partners only when a provider prescribes.

## Key facts
- Membership: Basic $25/month, Premium $155/month. Medication, when prescribed, is a separate charge.
- Bloodwork is arranged through mobile phlebotomy or partner draw sites (no mail-order kit) and analyzed in CLIA-certified labs.
- Completing an assessment does not guarantee treatment; a licensed provider decides.
- Compounded medications are not FDA-approved.
